[[Your Child (DS)|Possible son]] |rival = [[Griffin (DS)|Griffin]] |wife lunches = |unlock by = |appearances = [[Muffy (AWL)|AWL, AWLSE, AnWL]], '''DS, Cute''', [[Molly (SoSAWL)|SoSAWL]] |disliked animals = Dog}} {{Youmay|Muffy, a character from [[Harvest Moon DS]]|[[Muffy]] as she appears in other games throughout the series}} {{Nihongo|Muffy|ムー|Mū}} is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]] ''and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]. ''She is one of the eligible bachelorettes available to court in ''DS''. Muffy is the flirtatious bar maid working at the town's Blue Bar. She is outgoing, cheerful and friendly, but has a secret fear of getting her heart broken and a bad history with men. Because Muffy works in the evening, she has free time during the day. She enjoys spending time at the spring or standing on the bridge during sunny weather and will spend time at the Inner Inn during rainy or snowy days. In the evening, Muffy works at the Blue Bar serving drinks. On Wednesdays, Muffy will go to the city to shop for the day. colspan="2" |Wednesdays (Raining) |- |6am - 8am | Inside Her Bedroom | |- |8am - 9:40am |Walking to Mineral Town exit |- |9:40am – 4:10pm |In Mineral Town |- |4:10pm – 5:30pm |Walking to Inn |- |5:30pm - 9pm |Inside Inn |- |9pm - 9:20pm |Walking to Bar |- |9:20pm - 6am |Inside Her Bedroom |} ==Gifts[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/muffy.php Muffy] fogu.com== {{Infobox Gift |special = Apple Pie |loved = Jewelry (All), Diamond, Wine, Matsutake Mushrooms, Stir Fry, Wild Grape Wine, Curry Rice, Rainbow Curry, Ultimate Curry, Finest Curry, Baked Yam, Pizza, Cake, Chocolate Cake, Butter, Pumpkin Pudding, Salad, Mushroom Rice, Ice Cream |liked = Fruit (All), Moondrop Flowers, Chocolate, Sunblock, Facial Pack, Dress, Lotion, Bread, Flour, French Fries, Popcorn, Cornflakes, French Toast, Pancake, Pot Sticker, Risotto, Hot Chocolate, Dumplings, Marmalade, Cheese Fondue, Relaxtea, Baked Corn, Toast, Doria, Gratin, Sweet Potatoes, Chocolate Cookies, Cheesecake, Pineapple Juice, Banana Juice, Orange Juice, Ketchup, Green Dumpling, Steamed Dumpling, Pudding, Sandwich, Chirashi Sushi, Relaxtea Leaves |neutral = ''All items not listed.'' |disliked = Colored Grasses (All), Stones, Lumber, Happy Eggplant, Fried Thick Noodles, Fried Noodles, Noodles, Curry Noodles, Tempura Noodles, Buckwheat Noodles, Tempura Buckwheat Noodles, Bodigizer, Turbojolt, Vegetable Juice, Vegetable Latte, Bodigizer XL, Turbojolt XL, Pickled Turnips |hated = Ores (All), Gems (All, except Diamond), Toadstool, Pirate Treasure, Fish Fossil, Lithograph, Fish Bones, Empty Can, Boot, Weed, Branch, Stone, Gold Lumber, Fodder, Bird Feed, Fish Stew, Pickled Cucumbers, Elli Leaves |horror = Small Fish }} ==Heart Events== '''Black Heart Event''' In order to see this event, the player must walk into Blue Bar from 3pm to 5pm.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/muffy.php Muffy Heart Events] fogu.com When you visit the bar, Muffy asks what type of girl the player likes. If you say "cheerful and pretty", Muffy is happy and promises not to tell anyone. She then makes a drink, free of charge! It's her first time making it and it tastes terrible. {{Clr}} ---- '''Purple Heart Event''' The player must go to the beach from 9am to 11am on a rainy day (except Wednesdays), when that Muffy has a purple heart or higher. You must have already seen the black heart event.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/muffy.php Muffy Heart Events] fogu.com Muffy is upset when you arrive. When she sees you, she will ask if you can listen to her and give some advice. Agree to hear her out and Muffy will tell you that she's fretting because her parents set her up on a blind date. She isn't interested in meeting with his man, so she asks you what she should do. Tell her that she should reject the man after meeting him in person. She agrees that this would be more polite and thanks you for listening to her. {{Clr}} ---- '''Blue Heart Event''' Enter Blue Bar from 6pm to 8pm on any day except Wednesday when Muffy has a blue heart or more. All previous heart events must be previously watched.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/muffy.php Muffy Heart Events] fogu.com Muffy thinks it would be a good idea to help Griffin make some new drinks. She knows the first drink she made you wasn't very good, but wants to prove that she can do better! She asks for your help.. As she's finishing the drink, she asks you what the final ingredient should be. Tell her to use milk and it will turn out to be delicious! {{Clr}} ---- '''Yellow Heart Event''' In order to trigger this event, the player must walk into the farmhouse between 9:20am and 12pm. It can only be triggered in the Summer season during a sunny day. Additionally, Muffy must have at least a yellow heart and all previous events have to already been watched.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/muffy.php Muffy Heart Events] fogu.com As you leave your farmhouse, Muffy greets you. It's a beautiful day and Muffy asks if you'd like to go out on a date today. If you accept, the two of you will go to the Goddess Pond. After a short visit at the Goddess Pond, the two of you go to the beach. You get something to eat from [[Kai (DS)|Kai]] at the Food Shack who notices that you are out on a date. He treats you to a meal, free of charge! After eating, you and Muffy return to the farm. Muffy is very happy and admits that this was the first date she's actually enjoyed going on. ==Rival Events== '''Black Heart Event''' Visit the Blue Bar between 9am and 11am on any rainy day except for Wednesday to trigger this event.[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/griffin.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Muffy is asking Griffin is asking about his old days as a musician. Griffin tells her a story of an old sleeping guitar and his ancestor who used to play it. Muffy listens intently and enjoys his story. {{Clr}} ---- '''Blue Heart Event''' Walk from your farm to the town's main path between 10am and 11am any day of the week except for Wednesday. It must be Year 2 or later and the first rival event must have already been watched.[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/griffin.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Griffin sees Muffy looking out longingly on the bridge, and notices that she looks sad. Griffin confronts her, and Muffy explains that she just got a letter from her friend. Her friend is marrying a man that Muffy used to be associated with, and Muffy says that she is upset and feels like crying about it. Griffin says that she'll feel better after crying, and tells her to return to the bar whenever she's ready. {{Clr}} ---- '''Green Heart Event'''[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/griffin.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Walk into the Blue Bar between 9am and 11am on any rainy day, except for Wednesday. It must be Year 3 or later, and the previous two events must have already been seen.[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/griffin.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Muffy confides in Griffin that she is sad because she's never had much luck with men, and she's never dated a decent man before. Griffin tells her that she simply has poor judgement, and maybe she should try to date a man who lives in the valley. Muffy always looks for dates from the city, so she is happy for the suggestion of dating locally. She thanks Griffin.{{Clr}} ---- '''Orange Heart Event''' Walk into the Blue Bar between 9am and 11am on any rainy day, except for Wednesday. It must be Year 4 or later and all other previous heart events must have already been seen.[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/griffin.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Muffy is reflecting about what Griffin said about finding a local man to date. Griffin assures her that she needs to take her time, as Muffy explains that there hasn't been anybody so far that she can connect with. After telling Griffin that he's the only one that she can talk to, she realizes that Griffin has been the one all along! Griffin is flattered by Muffy's realization, and they are both happy to finally have somebody.  ==References== {{Reflist|3}} {{HMDSCharacters}} [[Category:Harvest Moon DS]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Bachelorettes]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute Rivals]]
